source.note: known-divergences.md (html-tag-in-frontmatter): in mermaid.js `title: <a` in the frontmatter starts a tag whose attribute part reaches the `>` in the label, so `="c"` is read as `='c'` and the label is `b='c'>d`. Here tags are found only in the text after the frontmatter, the `"` stays, and the flowchart grammar rejects the label.
